auditionDates.notes: Exact dates TBA — auditions take place annually in September. Check santacruzactorstheatre.org/auditions for the posted notice.

rolesAvailable.description: Actors may be cast in up to two plays and considered for Best of the Rest staged readings

prep.acting: Cold readings from scripts; scripts available at Santa Cruz Main Library (224 Church St) approximately two weeks before auditions

auditions.notes: The 8 Tens @ 8 is the world's longest-running festival of its kind, now in its 30th year. 16 ten-minute plays chosen from a global playwriting contest. Festival runs January–February 2027. Playwrights contest submissions close June 30, 2026.
